steps.name: Validate authority and permissions
steps.desc: Check caller authority, role scope, and permission tier.

steps.name: Validate required input fields
steps.desc: Verify all mandatory payload fields exist and are non-empty.

steps.name: Check auto-fail conditions
steps.desc: Evaluate if input or requested task violates any auto-fail condition.

steps.name: Validate task and goal alignment
steps.desc: Ensure work aligns with active Locked Goal and Execution Spec.

steps.name: Evaluate the role rubric
steps.desc: Execute role-specific work according to its measurable requirements.

steps.name: Validate evidence
steps.desc: Attach citations, logs, outputs, and factual artifacts.

steps.name: Validate output format
steps.desc: Ensure output strictly conforms to the Standard Return Contract.

steps.name: Return the result and next state
steps.desc: Transmit verified output payload to Hub or handoff receiver.
